note: The custom-node packs a run-graph manifest may name, each at the one commit it may be checked out at. A manifest that names a pack whose repository AND commit are not a row here is refused before any clone (render/node-packs.mjs, internal/mediacap/nodepacks.go). A change to this file is a change to what any holder of the fleet bearer can make a node run: a reviewed edit, with the Go copy in internal/mediacap/nodepacks.go changed with it (a test pins the two). pin says where the commit comes from: documented (docs/systems/media-generation.md) or unverified (the commit one reference node's checkout was at; confirm it against the fleet before relying on it).
